title: Writing / Voice / Playful
slide_intent: Make playfulness supportive and concise so a small creative surprise helps rather than distracts the reader.
strategic_value: Short language jokes and friendly celebration can give Duolingo character without turning every line into a performance.
demonstration: The page compares jolly, creative and briefly clever examples with smug, dry or overworked alternatives.
practical_value: Choose a small relevant verbal twist and remove sarcasm or excessive cleverness.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Playful heading, energy rationale and positive/negative trait lists at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange Jolly, Creative and Clever in quick doses comparisons at right, with checked preferred copy above alternatives.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source describes playful language as a burst of creative energy in a learner’s day.
reference_purposes.Expression: Multilingual wordplay and friendly congratulations demonstrate the intended character.
reference_purposes.Application: Paired samples distinguish useful creativity from dry or overworked copy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The trait list excludes sarcasm, smugness and excessive intellectual display.

ingredient.name: Playful voice
ingredient.role: Add lightness without excluding the reader.
ingredient.application: Use friendly creativity and short doses of wit; avoid sarcasm or smugness.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
